title: S01 Wide Open Bookcase
description: Original S01 freestanding wide shallow bookcase with four open horizontal book rows. Overall width 1.12 m, depth 0.34 m and height 1.80 m; metres, front -Y and ground-contact origin Z=0. Three fixed full-width intermediate shelves and the lower deck provide four long book surfaces, framed by warm-ivory side walls and crown, with a recessed seafoam backboard, two rear battens and a broad inset floor plinth. Each shelf has a nominal 0.98 m wide by 0.27 m deep flat placement rectangle; clear row heights exceed 0.35 m. Named closed components remain separately editable. Empty bookcase only, no books or props are included. Static visual furniture; no adjustable shelving, moving parts, book-fit validation, installation, load or tip-resistance certification.
